description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Setzer
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Red Card (0~2), removed after using Apex Red Card two times

description.name: Apex Red Card Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Red Card level by 1 after using 7 Support or Sharpshooter abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Setzer]

description.name: Apex Red Card Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Red Card level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Setzer]
